name: Kutsujoku
source:
Even though he's just a normal student, the protagonist is forced to attend an elite school in accordance with his father's will. Worse still, because everyone feels superior to him, he can't blend in with the crowd and is always alone.

However, in the midst of it all, there's still someone who treats him without discrimination, Ayana, and she becomes his moral support. But after an incident occurs, he misunderstands that she also disdains him like everyone else.

Affection turns into resentment. And as a result, the protagonist discovers something interesting -- He has the ability to manipulate others, but only their body, not their mind.

And thus, he decides to use this new-found power to satisfy his every desire.

[Translated from [url=http://www.bishop.gr.jp/products/ktjk/prologue.html]Official Site[/url]]
translation:
主角虽然只是一名普通学生，却按照父亲的遗愿被迫进入精英学校。更糟糕的是，因为每个人都感觉自己比他优越，他无法融入人群，总是孤独一人。

然而，在这一切之中，还有一个人对他一视同仁，绫奈，她成为了他的精神支柱。但事情发生后，他误会她也像其他人一样鄙视他。

感情变成怨恨。结果，主角发现了一些有趣的事情——他有能力操纵别人，但只能操纵他们的身体，而不能操纵他们的思想。

因此，他决定利用这种新发现的力量来满足他的每一个愿望。

[翻译自[url=http://www.bishop.gr.jp/products/ktjk/prologue.html]官方网站[/url]]
